import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 50)

# Ensure submission directory exists
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data from the input directory
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Authors in train: {train_df['author'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Create text data
train_text = train_df["text"].fillna("")
test_text = test_df["text"].fillna("")

# Create TF-IDF features
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.9,
    stop_words="english",
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_text)
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_text)

# Encode labels
label_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
y_train = train_df["author"].map(label_map)

# Split into train/validation (80/20) for model evaluation
X_train_final, X_val, y_train_final, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Train final shape: {X_train_final.shape}")
print(f"Validation shape: {X_val.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {X_test.shape}")

# Train Gradient Boosting
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=150,
    max_depth=4,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    min_samples_split=100,
    min_samples_leaf=40,
    random_state=42,
)

gb_model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

# Validation predictions
y_val_pred = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val)

# Calculate multi-class log loss on validation set
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred, labels=["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
print(f"Validation Log Loss (held-out): {val_log_loss:.6f}")

# Predict on actual test set (This fixes the bug where it used a split of training data)
final_model_test_pred = gb_model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Create submission file using test_df['id'] to ensure correct mapping
# The submission must have the same number of rows as the test set (1958)
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": final_model_test_pred[:, 0],
        "HPL": final_model_test_pred[:, 1],
        "MWS": final_model_test_pred[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save to submission directory
submission.to_csv(f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"\nAll submission statistics:")
print(f"EAP mean: {submission['EAP'].mean():.6f}")
print(f"HPL mean: {submission['HPL'].mean():.6f}")
print(f"MWS mean: {submission['MWS'].mean():.6f}")
